title: LOW HEALTH: THICKER RED OUTLINE, STAMINA STEPS BACK
why: The critic still scored low health 2 with a P0: the first cut was too faint in a picture and the pale stamina bar out-shouts the health bar. The outline is now 3px and never dimmer than 0.56 alpha, and under 25 percent health the stamina bar is drawn at 45 percent.
now: At low health the red outline is bolder and the stamina bar dims.
